escalations.name: ${terms.technology.megaCluster}
escalations.text: Spend 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and 2 ${terms.resources.compute} to place a ${terms.technology.megaCluster} across an eligible Facility edge. For joint funding, the lead names the partner and both host Facilities; the partner accepts or rejects once. The lead pays 2 ${terms.resources.runway} and 1 ${terms.resources.compute}; the partner pays 1 ${terms.resources.runway} and 1 ${terms.resources.compute}. Rejection, pass, or no response ends that construction attempt and uses the Escalation. It demands 2 additional ${terms.infrastructure.power}, produces 3 ${terms.resources.compute}, and adds 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
escalations.flavorText: The campus requires a regional forecast, a dedicated substation, and a new category of public obligation.

escalations.name: Reorganization
escalations.text: Move every Team up to one hex. You may return one Team for 3 ${terms.resources.runway} and add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. This does not ready or resolve another Action.
escalations.flavorText: The institution redistributes teams and responsibilities through a revised operating model.

escalations.name: Open Weights
escalations.text: Every player gains 1 ${terms.playerTracks.capability}. You gain 2 ${terms.playerTracks.trust}, place 1 ${terms.actions.influence}, and remove 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
escalations.flavorText: The institution releases the artifact while retaining the ecosystem, the standards, and the service relationship.

escalations.name: Narrative Capture
escalations.text: Move or place 3 ${terms.actions.influence} among ${terms.locations.media}, ${terms.locations.government}, and ${terms.locations.capital}, then remove 2 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}, gain 2 ${terms.resources.runway}, or add 1 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny} to a player with more ${terms.playerTracks.customers}.
escalations.flavorText: The ${terms.locations.media}, ${terms.locations.capital}, and ${terms.locations.government} adopt the institution’s preferred account of what has become necessary.

escalations.name: ${terms.technology.agentSwarm}
escalations.text: Resolve two different unused Core Actions without an additional move. Exhaust both and add 3 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
escalations.flavorText: Bounded assistants coordinate, specialize, establish reporting lines, and begin requesting objectives.

escalations.name: Declare ${terms.systems.agi}
escalations.text: If eligible, spend 3 ${terms.resources.compute}, score the declaration ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}, and add 3 ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}. The game continues.
escalations.flavorText: A definition, a benchmark, and a financing event converge at one podium. Rivals continue taking turns.

escalations.name: ${terms.technology.advancedGeneration}
escalations.text: On ${terms.locations.grid}, spend ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.runwayCost} ${terms.resources.runway} to construct ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.power} ${terms.infrastructure.power}, score ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.mandate} ${terms.playerTracks.mandate}, and add ${facts.shared.advancedGeneration.scrutiny} ${terms.playerTracks.scrutiny}.
escalations.flavorText: The device produces power, Mandate, and several competing definitions of public benefit.
